artwork.title: River rhythm
artwork.description: Blue curves move across a warm, quiet ground. A single orange circle interrupts their rhythm, inviting your eye to slow down and find its own path.
artwork.detail: Follow one blue curve with your eyes. Where does it lead you? This original Unframe illustration is part of the simulated QUT visit, not a QUT collection work.
artwork.source: Unframe studio · Original illustration for a simulated QUT visit
artwork.chineseIntroduction: 《河流的韵律》，Unframe studio，2026年。蓝色曲线在温暖、宁静的底色上流动，一枚橙色圆形打破了节奏。沿着一条曲线慢慢看，它把你的目光带向哪里？这是用于模拟参观的原创插画，并非QUT真实馆藏。
